text: With the neutron-to-proton ratio frozen at n/p ≈ 1/7, Big Bang nucleosynthesis locks nearly all neutrons into helium-4, giving a primordial helium mass fraction Y_p ≈ 0.25 — that is, about ___ percent by mass.
explanation: Using Y_p = 2(n/p)/(1 + n/p) with n/p ≈ 1/7 gives Y_p ≈ 2/8 = 0.25, so roughly 25% of the baryonic mass is helium-4 and about 75% remains hydrogen. This matches the observed value Y_p = 0.245 ± 0.003. The result depends on the expansion rate and the neutron lifetime, which is how BBN constrains the number of light neutrino species.
